notes.title: 1.0.2版本更新说明
notes.content:
在本次更新中，我们对游戏进行了如下更新：
1、目前游戏已经支持手柄控制
2、我们只做了一批新的游戏技能UI
3、我们对部分不优秀的动作进行了微调

notes.title: Announcement of our game discussion group
notes.content: First of all, I'm glad that you have experienced our game. This is the first game of our team. Later, we will make more improvements and optimizations to this game. I have created a QQ group. In the future, we hope to get more opinions and suggestions. We hope you can join our group chat. We will share the game plan with you as soon as possible, and rectify the bugs and other problems encountered by players.Looking forward to your support! Group number: 656033127

notes.title: V1.0.1 Update description
notes.content: In this version, we have modified the problem of blurry pictures that players have always criticized. In order to cater to various players, we have adjusted the difficulty of the game. At present, the game can set the difficulty through the options when starting a new game; We have optimized and redone some actions, and adjusted the monster's skills, numerical values and other attributes to make them more reasonable.
